description: Record a cash box deposit, a transfer from the cash box to the bank, a withdrawal from the bank to the cash box, or the cash box opening balance. Only the explicit bank transfers can be matched to a bank transaction.

kind.description: DEPOSIT adds cash, TRANSFER_TO_BANK deposits cash into the bank, TRANSFER_FROM_BANK withdraws, OPENING_BALANCE sets the starting balance. Defaults to DEPOSIT.

name: record_cash_transfer
title: Record cash box movement
